defaults.reason: This feature is not qualified for this provider and deployment.

access-surface: Derived from live provider access evidence.
code-audit: Deterministic rules over supply chain, code security, dependencies and project hygiene, each fixture-tested firing and staying quiet. Files are read through the Provider-verified exposure reader, package existence is asked of the public registries through the guarded transport, and an unreachable registry reads as unknown, never as missing. Findings name a place and never quote the code.
dependency-audit: OSV unavailability is reported as incomplete, never clean.
exposure.scan: Detection, identity, storage, the bounded job, verification and the readability probe are fixture-tested end to end; the provider-facing reader is exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness -- ref resolution, the tree at that commit bound to a file the run wrote, its blob read back exactly, and history walked to the commit that added it.
file.batch: Qualified single-commit batch: one tree carrying several paths, committed against the observed head, with a non-fast-forward ref move refused.
file.rename: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness: the blob is re-linked at the new path in one commit on the observed head, keeps its object identity, and leaves the old path empty. An occupied destination is refused rather than replaced.
findings.inbox: Every open finding across the workspace, read from the audit history and the exposure scans this identity holds; nothing is fetched from the provider, a store that cannot answer is reported unmeasured, and decisions are made through the repository's own triage routes.
folder.move: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness: every file under the folder, nested ones included, is re-linked under the destination in one commit on the observed head with its object identity kept, and nothing remains at the source. An occupied destination path is refused.
global-search: In the hosted alpha a code search is one scoped query per invitation repository, and that query is exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness: it finds the permanent search fixture, only in the target, and a word that exists nowhere finds nothing. Qualifiers that would widen the scope are refused.
governance: Policy lifecycle is available when Neon is healthy.
issues.read: Qualified issue list and detail reads, including absent-resource discrimination.
issues.write: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness: an issue is created, commented on and closed, each read back from the provider, and the read-only credential is refused.
lfs: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness: a synthetic object is uploaded to the LFS store and the provider withholds the upload action when asked again, without committing a pointer.
live-events: Exercised against the hosted staging deployment: a push to the sandbox repository is delivered by GitHub, its signature verified, streamed to a signed-in tester, and the webhook removed at the provider, in the operator-signed drill record the hosted gate requires.
native-push: Qualified Git Data object upload: the identity the provider returns is the git object hash of the bytes sent, and the object reads back unchanged. The hosted size ceiling is a deployment bound, not a capability limit.
notifications: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness: the inbox is read through a classic credential and scoped to the invitation repositories, and a fine-grained credential is refused by the product and by GitHub. Unavailable to fine-grained tokens and App installations, which GitHub does not serve.
pulls.read: Qualified pull-request list and detail reads, including absent-resource discrimination.
pulls.write: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness on disposable branches: a pull request is opened, reviewed, refused a merge against a head it no longer has, and merged against the head it reported.
recovery: Snapshot compare and restore preview are supported.
releases.read: Qualified release list and detail reads, including absent-resource discrimination.
releases.write: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness: a prerelease is published with its tag at the branch head it was cut from, read back, and removed with its tag.
repository.create: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness with an administration credential of a dedicated qualification account: a private disposable repository is created through the product after its identity check, and read back by name and by ID with its default branch.
repository.delete: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness: the same disposable repository is refused to an unprivileged credential, deleted with exact confirmation and the provider administrator permission, and read back as absent by name and by ID.
search: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness: the repository-scoped query finds the permanent search fixture, only in the target, and a word that exists nowhere finds nothing. Qualifiers that would widen the scope are refused.
site-check: An anonymous look at a deployed site through the guarded transport: GET only, HTTPS on 443 to public addresses (and one plain-HTTP request whose answer body is never read), no credential and no cookie, at most sixty bounded requests in forty-five seconds. The certificate and protocol, security headers, cookies, cross-origin reads, served secrets and diagnostics pages, error pages, up to five linked pages (honouring robots.txt), and the site's own scripts -- for shipped secrets, public source maps and library versions, which OSV is asked about -- are judged by fixture-tested rules, and the domain's SPF and DMARC records are read from public DNS. A file is reported as served only when its content has the shape that file must have, never quoted; a question that could not be asked is reported as not checked, never as passed; and a site that cannot be reached is an error rather than a clean report.
stars.read: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness: the account's star on the target is read, set, read, cleared and read, and left as it was found.
stars.write: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness: the account's star on the target is read, set, read, cleared and read, and left as it was found.
tree.read: Qualified recursive tree listing bound to the file it names.
upload-security: Built-in bounded signature gate is active; YARA is not implied.
workflows.read: Qualified workflow-run list and detail reads, including absent-resource discrimination.
workflows.rerun: Exercised by the alpha.17 live-provider harness: a dispatched run of the fixture workflow is re-run once finished, and the provider reports its next attempt.
workspace.posture: Read from the audit history, the exposure scans and the governance decisions this identity already holds; nothing is fetched from the provider, and a store that cannot answer is reported unmeasured, never clean.
